description:
Top Three Skills: Oracle, PL/SQL, Reports
 Job Description: Designs, develops, implements and maintains custom oracle  applications written in PL/SQL. 
 Develops and supports back-end data processing in PL/SQL. 

 Supports existing applications using Web PL/SQL Toolkit.
 Participates in the QA process through code review, test case and release notes preparation and certification of software.
 Relies on experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals.
 Performs a variety of tasks. Works under general supervision; typically reports to a Team Lead.
 Develops and customizes reports using Oracle Reports Builder, or supporting other reporting tools using SQL language.

 Education: BS (required) 
 Skills and Experience: Bachelor’s degree plus at least 2 - 5 years of experience in system analysis, design, and implementation of web-based applications. 

 Demonstrates hands-on experience in full development life cycle of enterprise scaled software applications utilizing Oracle technologies including Forms, Reports, SQL,PL/SQL, 10g/11g Database Server.
 Knowledge of C#, JSP, Java Servlet, JDBC, and Struts technologies is a plus.

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ months
